title: Freeze the approved RMS-descriptive spectral-bottleneck Spec
description: Register the user-approved revision as the only execution contract for the SB25 hiding retry.
acceptance_criteria: Spec status is approved and records that RMS CV is descriptive while the high-frequency gate remains hard.
review_initial_requirements: Confirm the approved wording matches the user decision and does not relabel r2.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm no host-diversity loss or RMS threshold remains and mechanism/victim stay blocked.

title: Implement the single-parameter Haar spectral bottleneck
description: Add bounded hf_subband_scale to the canonical residual path and bind the approved SB25 config through run_hiding_pilot.
acceptance_criteria: Scale 1.0 is forward and gradient equivalent to the old path; scale 0.25 attenuates LH HL HH; invalid values fail closed; no loss or RMS objective changes.
review_initial_requirements: Check the only active sink is raw_residual to DWT subband scaling to inverse to tanh.
review_regression_requirements: Check legacy constructors and scale 1.0 fallback remain equivalent and no downstream method changes.

title: Validate rollback equivalence and the SB25 parameter sink
description: Run focused carrier config hiding tests plus Python 3.8 compatibility and a cheap spectral probe.
acceptance_criteria: Scale 1.0 output and input/parameter gradients match baseline within tolerance; SB25 lowers Haar high-band energy; all focused and legacy SDH tests pass.
review_initial_requirements: Check deterministic finite forward backward and exact config to constructor binding.
review_regression_requirements: Check no RMS threshold in the revised gate and old configs retain scale 1.0 semantics.

title: Freeze and push the reviewed implementation candidate
description: Commit only the approved Spec CSV implementation config tests and review packet while preserving unrelated dirty files.
acceptance_criteria: A normal non-force push succeeds; exact commit and scoped file list are recorded; no data weights checkpoints temp files or credentials are included.
review_initial_requirements: Inspect staged diff tests and credential boundaries before commit.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm the commit reproduces the approved parameter path and excludes unrelated worktree changes.

title: Review the exact SB25 hiding-only retry
description: Audit CLI config runtime carrier sink tests frozen r2 baseline fresh remote paths cost cap and auto-shutdown before any GPU launch.
acceptance_criteria: Review passes only for an exact pushed commit with scale 0.25 active scale 1.0 rollback evidence fresh SB25 root and hiding-only command.
review_initial_requirements: Trace config to the canonical residual spectral bottleneck and revised hard gate.
review_regression_requirements: Check r1/r2 preservation no mechanism victim EOT JND RMS loss or AP claim and verify auto-shutdown.

title: Run the capped SB25 hiding-only pilot
description: Run only the approved seed-0 120-step SB25 hiding stage from the reviewed commit in a fresh root.
acceptance_criteria: Finite first progress GPU activity status and artifacts appear; run completes or stops safely within 20 minutes and auto-shuts down; no mechanism or victim starts.
review_initial_requirements: Check exact reviewed commit scale 0.25 config input hashes and fresh root are active.
review_regression_requirements: Check r1/r2 remain untouched and wrapper contains no mechanism victim EOT JND or RMS objective.

title: Pull and verify the minimal SB25 evidence
description: Pull status hiding metrics split log config binding and cost-guard evidence by manifest without the checkpoint by default.
acceptance_criteria: All required small files and hashes verify; r1/r2 remain unchanged; datasets weights checkpoints and credentials are excluded.
review_initial_requirements: Check the revised hard-gate fields and RMS descriptive field are present.
review_regression_requirements: Check exact formal and ready hashes no overwrite and no large artifact transfer.

title: Decide the revised SB25 hiding gate
description: Compare only the SB25 run to frozen r2 evidence and judge every revised Success and independent Failure Signal.
acceptance_criteria: Report exact metrics and hashes; RMS CV is descriptive only; any revised hard-gate failure blocks mechanism; no AP or UE claim is made.
review_initial_requirements: Check hypothesis evidence and thresholds without post-hoc rewriting.
review_regression_requirements: Check missing visuals PSNR LPIPS victim AP and single-seed boundaries are explicit.

title: Prepare the SB25 state candidate for user decision
description: Translate the hiding-only result into a candidate current truth or failed-path record without changing Current Best automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate preserves single-seed mechanical scope and requires user authority for STATE changes or mechanism continuation.
review_initial_requirements: Check the candidate is fully supported by pulled artifacts and HEN.
review_regression_requirements: Check no detector efficacy robustness transfer or SOTA claim is introduced.

title: Run the SB25 Spec-level claim and evidence review
description: Re-read the approved Spec CSV implementation tests pre-run remote artifacts HEN state candidate and Git scope.
acceptance_criteria: Output vision_met or gaps_found; every executable row and claim matches evidence; failures create explicit follow-up work and never bypass the hiding gate.
review_initial_requirements: Confirm all prior rows are truthfully closed or formally blocked.
review_regression_requirements: Check revised RMS semantics high-frequency gate claim boundary and artifact hashes end to end.
